suggestions.rationale: Chronic ankle instability or pain is associated with altered gait and weight-bearing patterns that may affect the knees. The population-level relationship does not by itself establish an individual medical nexus.
evidenceGaps: Medical nexus linking altered gait to secondary knee degradation

sourceReferences.note: Legal framework for evaluating a secondary relationship; does not establish the underlying medical relationship.

suggestions.rationale: Severe, chronic ankle sprains may be associated with acquired flatfoot deformity in some clinical contexts; individual examination and imaging are needed to determine whether that relationship applies.
